answer: Admission to a navigation-agent exchange costs a nonrefundable burn per key per epoch: 5 credits if the proposed haven route has 2 m of water over its highest seabed knoll at the tidal nadir, 10 otherwise. Verifiers recompute depth from signed survey and tide records and consume a receipt bound to key and epoch. Every alias pays afresh even if idle, so 10 keys burn at least 50 credits. The fee deters only attackers whose gains are smaller; wealth and forged surveys weaken it.
